name: cross jump jack
description: A jumping jack where your arms and legs cross over each other at the center. It raises your heart rate and warms up the whole body.
instructions: Stand with your feet together and arms by your sides.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead.
Jump again, crossing your legs and your arms in front of you.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm and continue for 30-60 seconds.
